# Super fixes formatting-based CSS warnings in its AI assistant workflow


By OpenTools Team


CSS comparisons and anchored previews need different diagnoses before an assistant recommends site changes.


##


Formatting is not a deployment change


[The November 2 changelog](https://changelog.super.so/) says saved‑versus‑live CSS checks could mistake` .22` becoming` 0.22` for outdated styles. The check now matches CSS as Super builds it, rather than treating that representation change as evidence for republishing or clearing caches.


##


A timeout is a separate diagnosis


[Links with a # anchor now render](https://changelog.super.so/) in AI‑assistant previews, Super says. If a preview still times out, the error points users to compare the requested path with the site’s page list instead of falsely describing a paid site as free.


The update describes diagnostic fixes, rather than a general site‑health check.
